scope: Owner-reviewed assessed-allele identity decisions. These records may establish which alternate allele a target interrogates only when the live curation pipeline independently confirms the same canonical ClinVar accession, coordinate and alternate. They do not override or upgrade clinical significance.

rs1799945.basis: ClinVar Variation ID 10 identifies the HFE p.His63Asp variant as C>G at the canonical GRCh38 coordinate. The owner-reviewed decision establishes assessed-allele identity G for this clinical target; it does not resolve the heterogeneous/conflicting condition-level clinical-significance submissions.
